questions: Task 7.4 invokes `openspec validate bootstrap-codex-computer-use-x11 --type change --json`. No prior artifact confirms the exact CLI shape of this command (flags, subcommand order). If the local OpenSpec CLI version does not accept `--type change`, the aggregate check will fail at apply time. Should the tasks (or test-plan Required Checks) note the fallback invocation form or link to the installed OpenSpec CLI help?
shouldFix: Task 4.1 and the test-plan's Slice 4 description use `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_codex-computer-use-x11") doctor --json` in shorthand prose. A Rust integration test must pass `doctor` and `--json` as separate `.arg()` calls; a literal single-string split will not work. The tasks should clarify or use `.args(["doctor", "--json"])` notation so the apply agent does not write a broken test by treating the invocation as a shell command.

The tasks never remind the apply agent to run `cargo fmt` (reformatting mode, without --check) before invoking `make fmt` (which only checks). If the generated code is not pre-formatted, Slice 6 RED evidence will be vacuously correct but the GREEN step will fail unexpectedly. Adding a note in task 5.2 or 5.3 that the apply agent must format the source tree with `cargo fmt` before the make-level check would prevent this silent trap.
summary: tasks.md is internally consistent and faithfully implements every slice from test-plan.md. Each TDD slice has a corresponding numbered task group with explicit RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR steps. The stable stage-01 check names (bootstrap-project, backend-identity, no-live-x11-probes), the exact planned-capability assertion (["x11-ewmh-windowing"]), the no-live-x11-probes detail string, the WindowObservationMeta documentation requirement, and the README MSRV-posture text requirement are all carried through from design-review and test-plan with correct gate weight. No unsupported assumptions were found: Cargo build-env macros, the openspec validate command, and CODEX_DESKTOP_LINUX_FULL_PATH isolation are all grounded in prior artifacts. No model or effort policy issues are present.
